text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Iraq calls for stopping illegal U.S. practices against its security and sovereignty.
- A vessel loaded with sugar bought by Iraq's trade ministry anchers at Umm Qasr port in the Gulf.
- A U.N. study published at the world body in New York says Iraq is subjected to severest trade sanctions.
- Activities of Baghdad trade fair continue.
(The above stories were also carried by THAWRA)
